node.title: Re^3: Grab username from WP Cookie
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
There should never be any information stored in a session cookie at all other than the name and session key. Anything else is bad security.

[mod://Mojolicious] has a different philosophy: its session data is actually stored in the session cookie, but it is cryptographically signed with the app's secret keystring to prevent tampering.
